question_text: In the ARIES database recovery algorithm, what is the role of the Analysis phase during crash recovery?

options.text: It reapplies all logged operations starting from the oldest uncommitted transaction
It scans the log forward from the most recent checkpoint to reconstruct the Dirty Page Table (DPT) and Active Transaction Table (ATT) at the time of the crash
It rolls back all active transactions in reverse order
It verifies cryptographic checksums of disk sectors

answer_explanation: ARIES has 3 phases: 1) Analysis: scans forward from checkpoint to identify active transactions and dirty pages at crash time; 2) Redo: repeats history; 3) Undo: rolls back losers.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: ARIES has 3 phases: 1) Analysis: scans forward from checkpoint to identify active transactions and dirty pages at crash time; 2) Redo: repeats history; 3) Undo: rolls back losers.
